name: Theeb Rent A Car Company
note: Saudi car-rental company listed on the Saudi Exchange main market, transportation sector, symbol 4261 (Argaam, 2021-03-29: shares debut on Tadawul on March 29, 2021). The company grew out of Theeb Establishment for Contracting, owned by Hamoud Abdullah Al-Theeb, since 1991 (Saudi Exchange company profile). After the IPO its largest shareholders were the founding Al-Theeb family members Hamoud Abdullah Al-Theeb and Mohammed Ahmed Abdullah Al-Theeb, 23% each, with Growth Opportunities Company for Trading at 21% (Argaam).
